title: Free-body diagrams and the combined effect of forces
goals: LOPS FY4: the combined effect of forces, the free-body diagram and the equation of motion
Skills: drawing a free-body diagram; vector quantities; trigonometry of the right triangle
Experimental: determining the forces acting on an object

Free-body diagram: the main teaching of the chapter, the student's guide "Drawing a free-body diagram" (eight steps); examples A, B, C (a pull at an angle and components), E, H (a helium balloon against the ceiling, challenge) and I; at least one draw-it-yourself task.
